messages.question: can you tell me a bit about yourself ?
answers: I’m Marin. I'm currently based in Paris. You already know I work as a dev, but that’s not all I’m about.
I love combat sports 💥 I’ve been doing Brazilian jiu jitsu for 2 years and 11 months and I started Muay Thai in May 2026.
I also can’t spend a day without either playing or listening to music. I’m a big fan of anything alternative, from pop to hardcore
Also I like to play along at the bass !

messages.question: what got you into coding?
answers: I was looking for a job in which I can express my creativity under a stricter guidance than arts. It seems like programming was the perfect match for my fussy brain lol
Besides I’m genuinely just curious about technology, and I want to be part of those who build it.
So that’s why I’m a dev ;)

messages.question: what’s your current goal?
answers: Career-wise, I just need a positive environment where I feel appreciated and where I don’t get bored. I don’t have a specific career plan in mind at the moment.
Otherwise, my main goal is simply to enjoy life and make sure I’m a fun person to be around. That’s pretty much everything!

messages.question: want to say anything else ?
answers: If you’re an employer, don’t hesitate to hit me up ! If you’re a friend, just send me some shitpost.
